request_user:
Fact: additional_assets
What to find: Other assets released with the model (training data, training code, inference or evaluation code, checkpoints) and how to access them.
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Resources, Links

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Code is on GitHub (OpenGVLab/InternVL), with conversion scripts between GitHub and HF checkpoint formats (custom2hf, hf2custom). Checkpoints from different training stages (Pretrained, Instruct, MPO, full CascadeRL) are released via HF and ModelScope links. The card's metadata lists datasets OpenGVLab/MMPR-v1.2 and OpenGVLab/MMPR-Tiny. Evaluation uses VLMEvalkit, and the VisualPRM-8B-v1_1 critic model is linked. The Flash version is to be released later.
quotes: > If you want to convert the checkpoint between these two formats, please refer to the scripts about [custom2hf](https://github.com/OpenGVLab/InternVL/blob/main/internvl_chat/tools/internvl_custom2hf.py) and [hf2custom](https://github.com/OpenGVLab/InternVL/blob/main/internvl_chat/tools/internvl_hf2custom.py).
Here, we also open-source the model weights after different training stages for potential research usage.
The Flash version of our model will be released as soon as possible.
